description:
Froststrap is a fork of Bloxstrap and Fishstrap, focused on performance and customization.


Froststrap v2.0.8 - What's New?
This one is an emergency patch from some issues deemed as an immediate triage- along side some other changes which are being brought in early.
Fixed
- Potential use-after-free in macOS titlebar augmentation during window closure
- Reference to dead icon resource in Avalonia tray creation causing tray to not deploy/show
Codebase
- Audit NativeMethods.txt to remove unused methods from codegen via CsWin32
- Fix build system expecting command succession due to an assumption of it thinning fat dylibs- which might not be the case causing user-initiated publish to fail
